* chore: update dependencies and resolve security alerts

  unused.

* v1.20

Regenerate both clients from the qdrant `dev` branch (e61cc860) and bump to
1.20.0. No new proto files and no new REST endpoints.

gRPC and REST:
- BM25 ranking over text indexes: `scoring` on text index params, and a
  `text` query (`TextQuery`, `Bm25Params`) that ranks by the field named
  in `using`. `IdfParams` now also applies to BM25.
- `substring` match condition for keyword fields.
- `nested` on every payload index params type, to index each object of an
  array (e.g. `offers[].price`) as its own entry.
- `max`, `min` and `acosh` formula expressions.
- `turbo8`/`turbo16` datatypes and the `bits8` TurboQuant bit size.
- Point id tracker params (`id_tracker`) on create/update collection and in
  collection params; collection info reports `created_at`.

REST: `createCollection`/`recreateCollection` forward `id_tracker`.
`updateCollection` already spreads its args. `GET /collections/{name}/points/{id}`
gained a `timeout` query param; it is not wrapped by `QdrantClient`, so only
the generated client changes.

Also add the generated sources to .prettierignore: lint-staged runs
`prettier --list-different` on staged *.ts, and codegen output never passed
it, so regenerating could not be committed with the hook enabled.

Integration tests cover the new surface on both clients and run against
`qdrant/qdrant:dev` until 1.20 is tagged (`QDRANT_LATEST="dev"`, as for 1.19).
REST 30/30 and gRPC 18/18 pass against dev@e61cc860.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Run integration tests against v1.20.0

CI is expected to fail until qdrant v1.20.0 is published; re-run it then.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add code tokenizer from qdrant#11180

Regenerate gRPC/REST clients for TokenizerType.Code and cover
camelCase/snake_case matching in integration tests.
